answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to validate network contributions. By acting as a digital ember, this capital expenditure creates a high entry cost for adversaries. Within a vast nebula of decentralized identities, the burn acts as a secure inlet for reputation, ensuring that each vote is backed by tangible economic sacrifice, thereby rendering the creation of infinite fake nodes prohibitively expensive for any attacker.
